archiveValidation.scope: SHA-256/SHA-512, sidecars, manifests, member sets, safe paths and every payload hash verified before extraction. Every relative import of the command service (main/enterprise/commands: receive, receiveV2, cooperative pause, local pause/resume) and the notice inbox client (main/enterprise/inbox: receipts, recovery) was redirected to the compiled desktop archive, and every import of the command ledger, executor, v2 reader/receipt and cooperative pause gate (shared/maestro-lib/managed/commands) to the public runtime bundle; four suites (commands, commands-v2, inbox, inbox-recovery) ran on those bytes. Bridge, CLI, host, Auto Run engine, renderer and conformance suites stay source-only. Public declaration checks and a plain Node load of both archives (a malformed v2 request refused with problems, the desktop names pause/resume uncomposed, an untracked run has no stop, a stopped run stops at its next boundary, an agent-input notice is no notice, the four acts are four keys bound to the actor) passed. Temporary identity-only pin leaves the historical runtime pin unchanged.

tests.boundary: Local typed-port and public-schema fixtures, the labeled contract-fixture endpoint daemon, temporary data directories and recording sinks only. No signed production command, real tenant, provider, native peer or live endpoint supplied authority.

behavior: A delivered commandRequestV2 is read into the existing typed command executor and durable ledger (envelope digest and registration bound); a duplicate answers from history, another actor is unauthenticated, another epoch is stale-run.

pause-run is cooperative: accepted at once, settled completed when the run reaches its next Auto Run task boundary (the task in flight finishes, no OS suspension), no-effect if withdrawn or the run ends first; resume releases the parked boundary; cancel stops at the boundary. The detached managed host composes it; the desktop names pause-run and resume-run uncomposed and records nothing.

Notices with agentInput true or operator_command kind are refused whole; delivered, read, acknowledged and a private reply are four exact receipts under actor-bound idempotency keys; offline acts stay uncertain, never claimed recorded, and resend under the first key; restart resends nothing already recorded; no notice body or reply text is written to disk or injected into a model.
Inbox receipt recovery (RECOVERY-LOCAL/1) is consumed only through an injected port; production composes none and answers unsupported.
maestro-cli reaches inbox list/act/recover and command issue/status/pause-run/resume-run over the desktop bridge and the detached host bridge (CLI secret only).

contractMappings.remaining: commandReceiptV2 cannot label a pause cooperative and no local endpoint operation carries receipt recovery; both are recorded proposals, implemented behind local seams and not advertised. Production command and notice actions still require authenticated negotiated authority (CP-01).
